acceptance: A pull request that changes the root pyproject.toml without relocking _project/sql-translation-ml fails a check, or the path dependency is gone
The check is wired into CI
description:
`_project/sql-translation-ml` depends on BenchBox by path, so its `uv.lock` embeds BenchBox's version and full requirement metadata. No check runs `uv lock --check` for that project, so the lock drifts whenever the root `pyproject.toml` changes: on 2026-10-22 it still described BenchBox 0.4.0 with older floors for dask, datafusion, duckdb and databricks-connect until it was relocked by hand. Any later dependency change repeats this.

Either add `uv lock --check` for `_project/sql-translation-ml` (and `_project/scripts`) to an existing lock gate such as `make uv-lock-revision-check` or the pre-commit lock hook, or remove the path dependency if the experiment no longer needs BenchBox's metadata.
